basic_info.description: Located in the Silver Terrace neighborhood, 20 Apollo Street is a single-family home known for its residential character and accessibility. Key Features: Built in 1943, this 3-level, 6 bedroom / 3 bathroom home is 2,138 sq. ft. (per graphic artist). The upper level offers 3BR's / 1BA, main level offers a remodeled kitchen, living/dining room, office, 2BR's and 1BA.  The lower level offers 1BR / 1BA (added with permits), a 1-Car garage with additional off-street parking in the driveway, laundry and a spacious rear yard. The property is currently tenant-occupied on a month-to-month basis, with long-term tenants paying $6,000 per month!!! Silver Terrace offers a comfortable residential atmosphere and convenient transportation, making it a desirable location for both homeowners and investors.
